title: Service Trust Portal and Privacy Principles

header.html: Describe the Service Trust Portal; Describe Microsoft's privacy principles; Describe the Microsoft Priva capabilities
the official SC-900 study guide, skills measured as of October 21, 2026

html:
1Service Trust Portal (STP)

The Service Trust Portal is Microsoft's public site for compliance documentation about its cloud services. It shows how Microsoft protects data and how its services meet standards. Sign in with a Microsoft account (or work account) to download.

Content Examples
Audit reports and certifications ISO/IEC 27001, SOC 1, 2 and 3, FedRAMP, PCI DSS
Compliance guides How to use Microsoft services to meet GDPR and other rules
Security assessments and white papers Penetration test results, risk assessments
Data protection resources Information on where data is stored and handled
My Library Save documents and get update notifications

Exam tip

. "Where do I find Microsoft's audit reports (SOC, ISO) for my auditor?" = Service Trust Portal. It documents Microsoft's compliance, while Compliance Manager (module 12) tracks yours.

2Microsoft privacy principles

Microsoft commits to six privacy principles:

Principle Meaning
Control You control your data, with tools to make choices
Transparency Microsoft is clear about how data is collected and used
Security Data is protected with strong security and encryption
Strong legal protections Respect for local privacy laws and fight for privacy as a human right
No content-based targeting Customer email, chat, files are not used to target ads
Benefits to you Data collection must bring value to you

Exam tip

. Memorize the six: control, transparency, security, strong legal protections, no content-based targeting, benefits. "Does not use customer content for advertising" = no content-based targeting.

3Microsoft Priva

Microsoft Priva helps organizations protect personal data and meet privacy rules.

Solution What it does
Privacy Risk Management Finds personal data in Microsoft 365, spots risks (such as data overexposure, transfers or hoarding) and suggests remediation
Subject Rights Requests Handles data subject requests (find, export, delete personal data) under rules like GDPR with a guided workflow
Privacy Assessments Help assess privacy impact of projects [Verify live]
Consent management Tracks consent [Verify live]
Exam tip

. Priva = privacy. Subject rights request = a person asks "what data do you hold about me?" or "delete it." Priva finds personal data and tracks the response.

4Exam Q&A

4.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1Fabrikam Outdoors' auditor asks for Microsoft's SOC 2 report. Where can the company get it?

  • AAzure Firewall for traffic filtering
  • BConditional Access sign-in policies
  • CService Trust Portal
  • DMicrosoft Sentinel for security analytics
Show the answer

Answer: C. The Service Trust Portal hosts Microsoft's audit reports and certifications.

S2Which Microsoft privacy principle states that customer email is not used to target advertising?

  • ATransparency
  • BBenefits to you
  • CControl
  • DNo content-based targeting
Show the answer

Answer: D. Customer content is not used for content-based advertising.

S3A customer asks a company to find and delete all personal data it holds about them. Which Priva capability helps?

  • ASecure score for configuration posture
  • BSafe Links for URLs in email
  • CPassword Protection with banned lists
  • DSubject Rights Requests
Show the answer

Answer: D. Subject Rights Requests supports finding and exporting or deleting personal data.

S4Which solution finds personal data and risks such as overexposure in Microsoft 365?

  • ADefender for Endpoint for device threats
  • BAzure Bastion for remote desktop access
  • CKey Vault for secrets, keys and certificates
  • DPriva Privacy Risk Management
Show the answer

Answer: D. Privacy Risk Management identifies personal data and privacy risks.

S5How many privacy principles does Microsoft state?

  • AThree
  • BTen
  • CSix
  • DTwelve
Show the answer

Answer: C. Microsoft lists six privacy principles.

S6Which principle means people can make choices about their data using tools?

  • AControl
  • BSecurity
  • CStrong legal protections
  • DBenefits
Show the answer

Answer: A. Control means customers manage their own data and choices.

4.2 Recall questions

R1What is the Service Trust Portal?

Show the answer

Microsoft's site for compliance documents, audit reports and guides.

R2Name the six privacy principles.

Show the answer

Control, transparency, security, strong legal protections, no content-based targeting and benefits to you.

R3What is Priva?

Show the answer

Microsoft's privacy management solution for personal data.

R4What does a subject rights request ask for?

Show the answer

Access to, export of, or deletion of a person's data.

R5What feature saves documents in the portal?

Show the answer

My Library.

R6Which regulation do subject rights requests relate to?

Show the answer

GDPR (and similar privacy laws).

5Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact

Privacy principles control, transparency, security, strong legal protections, no content-based targeting, benefits
